documents.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Basic Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A00
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Basic
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: This bundle's four filaments are PLA Basic: the store page's walkthrough table lists "PLA Basic Cyan #0086D6", "PLA Basic Magenta #EC008C", "PLA Basic Yellow #F4EE2A" and "PLA Basic White #FFFFFF", and its meta description calls it "a four-color bundle of PLA Basic filaments". The page links no TDS, SDS or hex-code document of its own, so every TDS/SDS value here is the PLA Basic document's value.

Hex entries are keyed by the colour names exactly as the PLA Basic hex-code table (p.1) writes them: Cyan #0086D6 (row 5, column 3), Magenta #EC008C (row 2, column 1), Yellow #F4EE2A (row 3, column 3), Jade White #FFFFFF (row 1, column 1). The product has no colour option (its groups are Bundle, Type and Size; values "CMYK Lithophane Bundle", "CMYK Lithophane Bundle + Backlight Board", "Filament with spool", "1kg*4"), so source_value_id is empty and each entry names its bundle item as the store page's walkthrough table writes it; the page's four hex codes agree with the table (the page says "PLA Basic White").

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (the registry has no *.printed / *.material split; raw-material properties are under material.* and thermal.*). The Z values (tensile 31 ± 3 MPa, elongation 7.5 ± 1.3 %, bending modulus 2370 ± 150 MPa, bending strength 59 ± 6 MPa, impact 13.8 ± 0.9 kJ/m²) are not stored.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa), melt index (23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption (0.43 %), spool material and size (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C; 200 mm diameter, 67 mm height), retraction, chamber temperature, overhang, bridging, humidity, support material. The store page's RFID sentence has no key either.

material.diameter_tolerance is neither stored nor listed as not_published: no document searched for this bundle states it, but Bambu publishes a tolerance for PLA Basic on the PLA Basic store page, so "not published by the manufacturer" would be untrue.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this bundle. The Bundle value "CMYK Lithophane Bundle + Backlight Board" adds a backlight board; its contents are not listed on this page.

safety.certifications is neither stored nor listed as not_published: no document searched for this bundle states one, but the PLA Basic store page states "certified to UL GREENGUARD 2904" and links Filament RoHS, POPs, CP65 and TSCA documents (not in the offline cache), so "not published by the manufacturer" would be untrue.

Adjudication against the second extraction (106 field disagreements): TDS locator wording keeps this file's form. thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (54 °C), as in every other filament file (the second took the 0.45 MPa row, 57 °C; both rows are in the TDS). material.net_weight is written as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure (the quote checker flagged 1000 g against the quote "1 kg"). printing.layer_height is removed: the store FAQ tip "layer heights between 0.08mm and 0.12mm" is a lithophane usage suggestion stored under a printer key, and it stays in the page's FAQ content. extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters is not written from the TDS "Nozzle Size 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm" row (a printer and hotend key; the row stays the nozzle relation, as in the other PLA files). The four hex entries and the AMS-series and Support for PLA relations are taken from the second after re-reading the hex table, the PLA wiki and the TDS; no separate AMS / AMS lite relations. The walkthrough-table relations are description_text (the page has no Compatibility section) and keep the store page URL; the requires-AMS relation carries its lithophane condition and stays target_kind family (ams_series), not the second's single "ams": the walkthrough cell links the store's whole AMS collection (collections/all-ams), not one AMS model. material.diameter_tolerance and safety.certifications are not declared not_published (see above). The AMS and AMS lite rows of the material-table wiki ("PLA* | Compatible") are not written as separate relations: the ams_series family relation covers them, as in the other PLA files. Every value, hex cell and relation quote was re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, hex table, the three wiki pages and the cached store page.
